supplementalBreakdowns.basis: New Jersey's 2024 domestic-health-insurer statements report $15.991560638B of direct Title XIX Medicaid premium across the five managed-care organizations identified in the state's 2024 Medicaid external-quality report. This calendar-year insurance-revenue view is supplemental—not additive—to Census public welfare, the state fiscal-year expenditure ledger, or federal-fiscal-year CMS-64 capitation. Direct premium is used consistently because Horizon cedes most of its premium through reinsurance; net premium would understate the state-paid business assigned to that plan.
